description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Create a brand, the workspace that events, team and payouts belong to: the first one for a new organiser, or another one. The signed-in person becomes its owner and it starts on the Free plan. Returns the new brand and its id; `set_context` with that brandId and the brand name makes it the active brand.

confirm.description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Pass `true` to execute. This is a programmatic backstop to the description tag. Destructive tools also require your approval through the client.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the business, such as US, GB or AU.

email.description: Contact email for the brand. Defaults to the account email.

legalName.description: Legal name of the business or person behind the brand.

name.description: Brand name, as buyers see it.

zip.description: Postcode or ZIP code of the business.

name: create_brand
title: Create brand
